reviewType: Independent read-only source review; no browser or source mutation
sourceStatus: Uncommitted MS06 candidate; exact bytes captured below. Not acceptance of later revisions.

findings.classification: Client context/lifetime carryover; not asserted authorization bypass
reproduction: Open Engagement Meetings with client A, select A meeting and read its Join link.
Change Engagement client scope to B without changing view.
The list query reloads for B, but selected state remains A. When B list settles, MeetingSplitView mounts A detail because selected is truthy even if absent from B rows.
The detail endpoint reads A by ID; matching A receipt enables A Join link under current B scope. Held old reads are aborted on split teardown, but the old selection initiates a new A read.
findings.evidence: Source-deterministic path; needs focused browser confirmation. Prior modal selection inherited same context gap; inline split newly exposes it with a B list beside A detail.
findings.suggestedRepair: Reset/key selection lifetime by client scope and mode; verify held old detail followed by replacement never reopens old material/link.

positiveChecks: Only a detail result matching selected meeting ID and known client association activates material tabs or Join. Summary joinLink is never used.
useCapiroQuery clears replacement/reload state and aborts superseded effects; key=selected.id remounts inline meeting/detail selection.
Explicit HTTP(S) prefix + safeWebsite excludes credentials, javascript/data, scheme-relative strings and absent links. rel noopener noreferrer/referrerPolicy no-referrer retained.
Modal remains default and starts Notes; inline starts Prep. Preparation content/empty disabled generation extracted without new endpoint or invented data.
Inline heading focuses on mount and close explicitly restores a connected list opener; responsive split is 280px+flex desktop, one-column below900.
Artifact read/write implementation is unchanged; current detail gate now blocks material access until detail read succeeds.
limits: No MS06 browser run by this reviewer; candidate root tests inspected only.

Filtered-away selection has no remaining row to restore focus to; current handler safely avoids focusing a missing ref.
